description: This file defines the `ModuleService` class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides methods to access and modify module data, including retrieving the list of modules and updating their status. It interacts with a `ModuleDao` object to perform data operations related to modules in the human resource management system.

classes.name: ModuleService
classes.description: Service class to handle module-related business logic such as retrieving the list of modules and updating their status.

methods.name: getModuleDao
methods.description: Retrieves the current `ModuleDao` instance, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: setModuleDao
methods.description: Sets the `ModuleDao` object to be used by the service.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of `Module` entities retrieved from the database.

methods.name: updateModuleStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of modules based on the provided array mapping module names to enabled status.
